verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an official MCP server on a dedicated product page that connects AI workflows to Pendo usage data. Pendo is also listed in Claude's official Connectors Directory, and Leo product intelligence is offered in Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, so the core story of connecting an agent through an official MCP server is covered. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the MCP tools and auth/setup beyond Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Pendo with your AI workflows to get instant access to usage data, visitor behavior, and customer context, wherever you work.
Pendo is available in Claude's official Connectors Directory. Set up the integration directly from Claude, no manual configuration needed.
official MCP server documented at https://www.pendo.io/product/mcp/
Product intelligence in Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more.
